indicators.label: Where source-linked records exist
indicators.formula: count(distinct source-linked event rows) by cell and source

indicators.label: Detections relative to documented effort
indicators.formula: detections / compatible effort within the same method, scope and time bucket
indicators.denominator: source-reported effort in its declared unit
indicators.allowed_claim: reporting or detection rate under the documented protocol
indicators.forbidden_claim: population trend without a fitted observation model

indicators.label: Habitat structure by measured plot or site
indicators.formula: source-compatible summaries of canopy cover, height, vertical strata, litter and stem counts
indicators.denominator: number of measured plots or points
indicators.forbidden_claim: recovery or causal treatment effect without a valid comparison design

indicators.label: Woody regeneration composition and stem-size structure
indicators.formula: individuals or basal-area proxy by species, plot and declared size class
indicators.allowed_claim: composition and structure of sampled plots
indicators.forbidden_claim: landscape-wide recruitment until plot area and design are applied

indicators.label: Restored, naturally regenerating and benchmark comparison
indicators.formula: predeclared contrast with uncertainty, respecting paired or blocked design
indicators.denominator: survey visits and sampled plots per treatment
indicators.allowed_claim: association or effect supported by the admitted design
indicators.forbidden_claim: restoration effect from unmatched occurrence totals
indicators.next_step: Implement a treatment-aware result operation with per-visit denominators, site-level replication and uncertainty.

indicators.label: Plot structure and composition relative to declared reference plots
indicators.formula: area-normalised stocks and trait-qualified richness by plot; optional abundance-based Chao similarity to compatible declared reference plots
indicators.denominator: sampled plot area for stocks and all compatible declared reference plots for similarity
indicators.allowed_claim: structure, composition or reference similarity of sampled plots
indicators.forbidden_claim: landscape-wide stock, causal treatment effect or complete recovery
indicators.next_step: Add parity-tested derived plot planes, then expose raw plots, intervals and reference distributions through one parameterised operation.

indicators.label: Explicit subject-object associations retained by a source
indicators.formula: count immutable source rows explicitly joining subject A and object B
indicators.denominator: source-reported association rows; use eligible observation effort when available for a rate
indicators.allowed_claim: the relation explicitly retained by the source, with its original semantics
indicators.forbidden_claim: dispersal, predation, facilitation or causality from proximity alone

indicators.label: Acoustic space use and verified vocal detections
indicators.formula: short-time Fourier transform summaries by frequency and time plus separately validated species detections
indicators.allowed_claim: recorded acoustic activity or verified vocal detections
indicators.forbidden_claim: species absence or abundance from an uncalibrated classifier

indicators.label: Seasonal vegetation profile
indicators.formula: versioned seasonal reflectance/index curve with start, peak and end estimates and uncertainty
indicators.forbidden_claim: flowering, fruiting or species-level phenophase without field calibration
indicators.next_step: Add multi-year cloud-screened curves and field phenophase calibration; the 2024 cube exposes missing cloudy-season support.

indicators.label: Where wider data can responsibly inform the target
indicators.formula: fit on donor data; evaluate with spatially separated folds; expose environmental support, calibration and uncertainty in target cells
indicators.denominator: independent or spatially blocked evaluation records
indicators.allowed_claim: modelled relative suitability within supported target conditions
indicators.forbidden_claim: presence, probability of occurrence or transfer where gates fail
indicators.current_stage: The ready capability produces a normalised 64-axis environmental-analogue score with leave-one-spatial-block-out support thresholds; it is not labelled relative suitability.
indicators.next_step: Fit and persist versioned baseline and candidate models with compatible effort or target-group background, spatial folds, discrimination, calibration and uncertainty gates.

indicators.label: Where one more survey could change a decision most
indicators.formula: expected improvement in decision value from a candidate observation, net of declared cost or risk
indicators.forbidden_claim: generic field request or unsafe access recommendation

indicators.label: Modelled soil context and where field sampling matters
indicators.formula: median and 90% prediction interval by property, depth and cell
indicators.denominator: model support plus number of local validation samples
indicators.allowed_claim: global-model soil context with quantified uncertainty
indicators.forbidden_claim: measured local soil condition without field samples

handle sampling bias when fitting presence-only models
construct spatially or environmentally separated validation folds
optimise survey locations against an explicit conservation decision and uncertainty
quantile predictions and uncertainty for global soil context

source-linked formulas and visual methods for plot stocks, trait-qualified richness, reference-community similarity, canopy-response models and exploratory enrichment simulation; operational gates are recorded in methods/method_cards.json
